svg.title: Namma Civic system architecture with official Google Cloud and Firebase product icons
svg.desc: Connected target: React SPA on Firebase Hosting calls the Hono API on Cloud Run, which uses Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Storage and bounded Vertex AI Gemini. Application code determines civic and connection outcomes. The static device-only frontend is live on Firebase Hosting Spark, verified 18 October 2026. Connected backend and Vertex/Gemini services remain undeployed and unverified.
svg.text: Civic accountability, local community and consent-based connections
API: ward routing, privacy, limits, transactions
Shared: priority, SLA, state, quorum, ledger
Schema + task checks → one repair retry
Private AI audits + approved public trails
All mutations and private connection reads pass through the API. Code determines civic outcomes.
Optional user-reviewed outreach: API → Resend email | Browser → X composer
Verified 18 Oct 2026; browser-only; no connected API
Real ward geometry + fictional city records
Fictional People profiles and incoming requests
IndexedDB: captured media and community posts
Product artwork: official Google Cloud icon library + Firebase brand assets. Frontend live; backend diagram reflects source architecture, not deployed services.
